title: Topic Modeling: Contextual Token Embeddings Are All You Need
venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2024
task: Topic discovery with phrase labels, hierarchy and topic spans
problem: Existing models do not jointly solve choosing the number of topics, labelling topics, segmenting documents by topic and evaluating topic-document representativeness.
architecture: Contextual-Top2Vec: contextual token embeddings from an SBERT model are mean-pooled in sliding windows to give multiple vectors per document; UMAP + HDBSCAN find dense areas whose centroids are topic vectors; hierarchical topic reduction merges smallest topics; token-level topic assignment gives topic spans; topics labelled with phrases. BERTScore recall/precision proposed for evaluation.
key_results: 20newsgroups: CNPMI 0.138 and CV 0.684 vs CTM 0.032 and 0.615.
Topic assignment: AMI 0.582 / ARI 0.442 vs Top2Vec 0.574 / 0.437 (20newsgroups).
BERTScore F1 0.409 vs 0.351 for Top2Vec; run time 4 min vs 1 min for LDA and BERTopic.
strengths: Handles multi-topic documents via segments and gives phrase labels.
Proposes an evaluation of how representative topics are of their documents.

limitations.text: Pretrained embeddings may miss corpus nuances and introduce external bias; metrics cannot capture all nuances.
Top2Vec is better on CWE (0.126 vs 0.116 on 20newsgroups); topic assignment gains over Top2Vec are within standard deviation.
